{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study quantifies the concordance between preclinical animal model results and human clinical outcomes for CNS active drugs, specifically assessing the prediction of tolerable and pharmacologically active dose ranges. It reports overlap percentages and analyzes translation rates, fulfilling the inclusion criteria.",
  "arm": "efficacy",
  "arm_evidence": "The aim of the current paper was to investigate the accuracy with which the IB preclinical package can predict tolerable and pharmacologically active dose ranges for CNS drugs in humans. We assessed the overlap between preclinical and clinical well-tolerated dose levels and pharmacologically active dose ranges.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "neurology-stroke",
    "neurodegeneration",
    "psychiatric",
    "pain",
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Drug development programs for neurological and psychiatric diseases have a high failure rate... CNS drugs... The study focuses on CNS active drugs and mentions indications like Alzheimer's disease, schizophrenia, ADHD, pain, and glaucoma.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "All in vivo behavioural pharmacology and safety preclinical study results reported in the included IBs were extracted, regardless of species or outcome... The IB-derisk tool was applied to IBs of included compounds.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat",
    "dog",
    "guinea-pig",
    "rabbit",
    "ferret",
    "pig",
    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "Table 1 shows that various species were included in the preclinical studies: Dog, Mouse, Rat, Micro-pig, Mini-pig, Guinea pig, Rabbit, Ferret, Monkey.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study assesses both tolerable dose ranges (related to safety/adverse events) and pharmacologically active dose ranges (related to efficacy/mechanism of action), using parameters like NOAEL, HLR AE, HUR AE, ALR a, AUR a, HLR a, and HUR a."
